Code of Conduct

Source: CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md

Our Commitment

As the maintainer of the pitchimpact project, I am committed to fostering a respectful, welcoming, and inclusive environment for everyone.

Participation in this project should be a positive and harassment-free experience, regardless of age, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, education level, nationality, socioeconomic status, physical ability, or any other personal characteristic.

The goal is to build an open and collaborative community where people can contribute, learn, and grow with mutual respect.

Our Standards

Examples of behavior that contribute to a positive environment include:

  • Showing empathy, respect, and consideration for others
  • Being open to different perspectives and experiences
  • Giving and receiving constructive feedback in a respectful manner
  • Acknowledging mistakes, apologizing when appropriate, and learning from them
  • Prioritizing what benefits the community as a whole

Examples of unacceptable behavior include:

  • The use of sexualized language or imagery, or any form of harassment
  • Insulting, derogatory, or personal or political attacks
  • Public or private harassment of any kind
  • Sharing someone’s private information without explicit permission
  • Any conduct that could reasonably be considered inappropriate in a professional or academic setting

Enforcement Responsibilities

The project maintainer is responsible for clarifying and enforcing this Code of Conduct
and will take appropriate and fair corrective action in response to any behavior deemed inappropriate.

This may include warnings, editing or removing content, moderating discussions,
or, in serious cases, suspending or banning contributors.

Decisions will be made with fairness, transparency, and respect.

Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to all spaces associated with the pitchimpact project, including:

  • GitHub repositories
  • Issues and Pull Requests
  • Discussions and documentation
  • Any other communication channels related to the project

Reporting and Contact

If you experience or observe behavior that violates this Code of Conduct,
please contact the project maintainer:

📧 Mateo López – mateandreslopez@gmail.com

All reports will be handled with confidentiality, respect, and prompt attention.
The privacy and safety of those who report incidents will be protected.

Enforcement Guidelines

Project maintainers will follow these general guidelines when determining consequences:

1. Correction

Impact: Use of inappropriate language or behavior without harmful intent
Action: A private message explaining why the behavior was inappropriate and how to improve
A public apology may be requested

2. Warning

Impact: A single or repeated minor violation
Action: A formal warning with clear expectations for future behavior
Temporary restrictions on interaction may be applied

3. Temporary Suspension

Impact: Repeated or serious misconduct affecting the community
Action: Temporary suspension from participating in project spaces
No interaction with the project during the suspension period

4. Permanent Ban

Impact: Ongoing or severe misconduct, including harassment or abuse
Action: Permanent removal from the project and all associated spaces

Acknowledgment

This Code of Conduct is adapted for the pitchimpact community from the
Contributor Covenant, version 2.0.
